abstract.p: Compounds, compositions, and method useful for treating a viral infection, such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and/or hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, are disclosed. In particular, prodrugs of phosphonamide nucleotide analogues and methods for their preparation and use as therapeutic or prophylactic agents are disclosed.
